correctness.rationale: The proof reduces feasibility to Hamming diameter, applies the published Kleitman/Frankl extremal bounds in their valid ranges, explicitly excludes the diameter-three equality family, and gives constructions whose geodesics are checked by pair type. Exhaustive enumeration independently reproduces all cases through Q_4.

originality.rationale: Targeted published-finding corpus and current-literature searches for k-distance mutual visibility of hypercubes, the exact mu_2 and mu_3 formulas, and the anticode reduction found no equivalent result; nearby work treats unrestricted visibility, visibility colorings, or different hypercube invariants.

value.rationale: The theorem exactly determines the first two nontrivial distance-limited visibility levels on hypercubes, reveals the exceptional parity construction in Q_4, and links a recent graph parameter to classical extremal set theory in a reusable way.
